India’s breakfast is as diverse as its culture! Every region has its own ingredients, flavours and traditions that make its morning meals truly special.
In this video, we’re taking you on a delicious breakfast journey across 5 regions of India, featuring some of their much-loved favourites.
From the spicy and flavourful Kolhapuri Misal of Maharashtra and soft Khaman Dhokla from Gujarat, to delicate Neer Dosa from Karnataka, Bengali-style Chire Pulao and comforting Aloo Paratha from Punjab — each recipe brings a completely different taste to the table.
